strategy: Upgrade weapons constantly while using War Plans activities like Helltides and Pit runs at appropriate levels. Prioritize difficulty levels that maintain fast clear speed with XP multipliers, tempering gear early and imprinting powerful Legendary Aspects to accelerate progression toward level 70.

paragon.note: Under Paragon 200, use a Board Rush for legendary-node power before respeccing. Maxroll shows this build's Paragon board pathing through an interactive planner (D4Planner) rather than as plain text, so the exact board order can't be faithfully scraped - check source_url for the visual layout.
